leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the currentColor keyword to inherit color values across CSS properties.
Configure opacity to control the transparency of HTML elements.
Integrate currentColor with border and box-shadow properties for consistent theming.
Manipulate background and text color opacity using RGBA and HSLA color models.
Construct layered visual effects by combining opacity with pseudo-elements.
Update element states (like :hover) using currentColor for dynamic styling.
Render semi-transparent overlays by adjusting opacity on positioned elements.
